steps: Upload the PDF file you want to shrink.
Click Compress and download the smaller file.

items.a: Yes, compressing PDFs is free within the daily usage limits shown above.
Stronger compression reduces image quality more; Basic keeps quality closer to the original while still reducing size where possible.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
